upload_large_folder_basic: upload a large folder to the HuggingFace Hub using the hf CLI command
upload_large_folder_revision: upload a large folder to the HuggingFace Hub with a specific revision tag
upload_large_folder_patterns: upload a large folder to the HuggingFace Hub with include and exclude glob patterns
upload_large_folder_workers: upload a large folder to the HuggingFace Hub with a custom number of parallel workers
upload_large_folder_quiet: upload a large folder to the HuggingFace Hub with progress bars and status reports disabled
